title: Angular Developer - Remote
description:
At INDI, we're passionate about empowering individuals and businesses worldwide. Our cutting-edge recruiters connect leading companies with top talent, fostering a dynamic environment where innovation thrives. Join us in shaping the future of work.


Overview of the role:


We are looking for Angular Developers to join our Development team and participate in different projects made up of multicultural teams distributed throughout the world. We are looking for proactive people, team players passionate about programming in this language and oriented to provide the best experience to the end user. This is an excellent opportunity for those professionals looking to develop in one of the fastest growing companies in the industry!

These developers will face numerous technical challenges, so they must use current technologies, get involved in the mobile world, web applications, devices, etc.


Key responsibilities:


- Develop, code, test, and debug application programs of varying degree of complexity.

- Code user interfaces with the latest frontend technologies

- Work with business users to develop and implement acceptance tests to ensure that product meets customer requirements and expectations.

- Ensure high performance of all systems developed.


Requirements:


- 4+ years of experience working as a developer.

- 2+ years of experience in Angular 2+.

- Experience in developing applications using Angular/Java technology stack.

- Solid experience with HTML, CSS, and writing cross-browser compatible code.

- Strong knowledge of AJAX and JavaScript Dom manipulation Techniques.

- Experience with MSSQL and/or PostgresSQL

- Experience with React is a plus.

- Advanced English level.


Benefits:

• Flexibility: Choose where and how you work for enhanced creativity and innovation.

• Tailored Compensation: Personalize your earnings to suit your financial goals.

• Tech-Driven Tools: Access cutting-edge resources for seamless collaboration and productivity.

• Autonomous Workflow: Take control of your schedule to achieve work-life balance.

• Well-being: Enjoy generous leave policies for rest and rejuvenation.

• Diversity & Inclusion: Thrive in a diverse and inclusive environment.

• Collaboration: Engage with industry leaders for collective growth.

• Development: Access mentorship and growth opportunities for continuous advancement.


If you are interested in being part of a team composed of the best professionals and working 100% goal-oriented in an innovative environment, but with the structure and resources of a multinational market leader, do not hesitate to apply!

title: Partner Lead - Creator & IRL Business
description:
The position can be based anywhere in Latin America (Fully Remote).


About TVU Networks

TVU Networks is redefining how live content is created and distributed, from global broadcasters and sports leagues to the fastest-growing creator ecosystem.

As live streaming evolves from studios to the streets, from TV to creators, TVU provides the infrastructure powering reliable live video anywhere, trusted by major media organizations and top streamers worldwide.

The next phase of growth is expanding our creator and IRL ecosystem globally, and LATAM is a key frontier.



Role Overview

We are looking for a strong Partner Lead to build and scale TVU’s content creator ecosystem across Latin America, Spain and Portugal.

This is a highly entrepreneurial role focused on developing partnerships with agencies, creators, production partners, and resellers, while driving revenue growth across hardware, connectivity, and self-served SaaS solutions.

Based in Latin America (fully remote), reporting to the VP of Content Creator Unit, you will act as the local engine of growth, helping partners succeed, unlocking new markets, reducing operational friction, and ensuring creators can adopt TVU seamlessly.

This role sits at the intersection of sales, partnerships, market development, and community building.


What You'll Do

  • Recruit and activate partners (agencies, resellers, production, creator networks)
  • Drive revenue across packs, data, support and mobile apps.
  • Support partners through deals, logistics, and deployments
  • Build relationships with top creators and emerging talent
  • Identify growth opportunities and execute locally
  • Help solve operational and market entry challenges
  • Collaborate with global partner and regional teams


Success Looks Like

  • Strong partner network across key LATAM, Spain & Portugal markets
  • New creator and partner deals closed
  • Growing regional revenue contribution
  • Clear pipeline and local momentum
  • Partners actively selling and advocating for TVU


Who You Are

  • Entrepreneurial and hands-on
  • Strong network in media, creators, streaming, or tech
  • Comfortable owning revenue outcomes
  • Fluent Spanish and English (Portuguese a big plus)
  • Thrive in fast, ambiguous environments


Why This Role

  • Remote position anywhere in Latin America with high autonomy
  • Be part of a fast-paced, fast-growing Silicon Valley company with 300+ team members worldwide
  • Work at the center of the rapidly evolving creator economy
  • You’ll help shape how the next generation of live creators operates, with real ownership, global visibility, and direct impact on growth



Please note that your application will only be considered if your CV and email are sent directly to:  


TVU Networks is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive workplace. We welcome applications from candidates of all backgrounds and encourage those who meet the qualifications to apply.


Please note that only shortlisted candidates will be contacted for an interview.

title: Partner Lead - Creator & IRL Business
description:
The position can be based anywhere in Latin America (Fully Remote).


About TVU Networks

TVU Networks is redefining how live content is created and distributed, from global broadcasters and sports leagues to the fastest-growing creator ecosystem.

As live streaming evolves from studios to the streets, from TV to creators, TVU provides the infrastructure powering reliable live video anywhere, trusted by major media organizations and top streamers worldwide.

The next phase of growth is expanding our creator and IRL ecosystem globally, and LATAM is a key frontier.



Role Overview

We are looking for a strong Partner Lead to build and scale TVU’s content creator ecosystem across Latin America, Spain and Portugal.

This is a highly entrepreneurial role focused on developing partnerships with agencies, creators, production partners, and resellers, while driving revenue growth across hardware, connectivity, and self-served SaaS solutions.

Based in Latin America (fully remote), reporting to the VP of Content Creator Unit, you will act as the local engine of growth, helping partners succeed, unlocking new markets, reducing operational friction, and ensuring creators can adopt TVU seamlessly.

This role sits at the intersection of sales, partnerships, market development, and community building.


What You'll Do

  • Recruit and activate partners (agencies, resellers, production, creator networks)
  • Drive revenue across packs, data, support and mobile apps.
  • Support partners through deals, logistics, and deployments
  • Build relationships with top creators and emerging talent
  • Identify growth opportunities and execute locally
  • Help solve operational and market entry challenges
  • Collaborate with global partner and regional teams


Success Looks Like

  • Strong partner network across key LATAM, Spain & Portugal markets
  • New creator and partner deals closed
  • Growing regional revenue contribution
  • Clear pipeline and local momentum
  • Partners actively selling and advocating for TVU


Who You Are

  • Entrepreneurial and hands-on
  • Strong network in media, creators, streaming, or tech
  • Comfortable owning revenue outcomes
  • Fluent Spanish and English (Portuguese a big plus)
  • Thrive in fast, ambiguous environments


Why This Role

  • Remote position anywhere in Latin America with high autonomy
  • Be part of a fast-paced, fast-growing Silicon Valley company with 300+ team members worldwide
  • Work at the center of the rapidly evolving creator economy
  • You’ll help shape how the next generation of live creators operates, with real ownership, global visibility, and direct impact on growth



Please note that your application will only be considered if your CV and email are sent directly to:  


TVU Networks is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive workplace. We welcome applications from candidates of all backgrounds and encourage those who meet the qualifications to apply.


Please note that only shortlisted candidates will be contacted for an interview.

title: Clinical Statistical Programmer
description:
Job Title: Clinical Statistical Programmer (SAS / CDISC)

Location: Brazil (Remote)

Duration: Long Term Contract


Role Summary:

We are seeking a detail-oriented Clinical Statistical Programmer to support clinical trial data standardization, analysis, and regulatory submissions. The ideal candidate will have strong expertise in CDISC standards (SDTM & ADaM), SAS programming, and generation of Tables, Listings, and Figures (TLFs), along with experience in quality control and submission readiness.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Transform raw clinical trial data into CDISC-compliant SDTM and ADaM datasets
  • Develop, validate, and maintain Tables, Listings, and Figures (TLFs) for clinical study reports and regulatory submissions
  • Write efficient, well-documented SAS programs for data cleaning, derivations, and reporting
  • Develop reusable Python or R scripts for automation, validation, and reproducible reporting
  • Perform programming QC and peer reviews to ensure accuracy and traceability
  • Prepare and maintain programming specifications, mapping documents, and annotated CRFs
  • Troubleshoot complex data integration and derivation issues
  • Support audits and regulatory inspections with reproducible code and documentation


Required Qualifications:

  • Strong experience with SAS programming
  • Hands-on experience with CDISC standards (SDTM & ADaM)
  • Experience generating TLFs for regulatory submissions
  • Knowledge of clinical trial data structures and submission processes
  • Familiarity with Python or R for automation (preferred)
  • Strong attention to detail and documentation practices


Preferred:

  • Experience supporting FDA/EMA regulatory submissions
  • Prior experience in a Pharma, Biotech, or CRO environment

title: Arquiteto de Integração
description:
Estamos em busca de um Arquiteto de Integração altamente qualificado para atuar em projetos de grande complexidade e impacto estratégico. O profissional será responsável por garantir a evolução arquitetural e tecnológica das integrações corporativas, promovendo soluções eficientes, escaláveis e aderentes às melhores práticas de mercado. Esta posição exige sólida capacidade analítica, profundo conhecimento técnico e forte atuação colaborativa com times multidisciplinares.


Responsabilidades:


  • Analisar, desenhar e manter o desenho de solução de integração para múltiplos projetos e sistemas;
  • Avaliar a arquitetura AS-IS e projetar a solução TO-BE , elaborando documentos técnicos de arquitetura de integração, definindo datamapping , swagger das APIs e garantindo aderência ao TMFórum, OpenAPI e 4P , conforme a arquitetura de referência;
  • Realizar análise técnica de requisitos, identificando sistemas impactados e definindo a solução de integração mais apropriada;
  • Garantir o desenvolvimento e a implantação das soluções de integração;
  • Acompanhar o ciclo completo de desenvolvimento das integrações, assegurando qualidade técnica e cumprimento de prazos;
  • Projetar, especificar e implementar APIs e Microserviços (criação e evolução), apoiando iniciativas de transformação digital;
  • Desenvolver backends utilizando Spring, SpringBoot e Node.js .;
  • Contribuir para a avaliação e implantação de novas tecnologias e práticas DevOps;
  • Orientar, acompanhar e validar o desenvolvimento realizado pela equipe (Júnior, Pleno e Sênior);
  • Realizar troubleshooting técnico;
  • Acompanhar implantações em produção e dar suporte ao início da operação;
  • Elaborar estimativas de esforço de desenvolvimento.


Requisitos:


Obrigatórios:


  • Experiência em desenvolvimento utilizando arquitetura de Microserviços;
  • Conhecimento em padrões de segurança para microserviços: JWT , protocolo OAUTH , SSL 2Way;
  • Domínio em desenvolvimento de API REST;
  • Conhecimento em SOA – Arquitetura Orientada a Serviços;
  • Vivência em soluções com arquitetura distribuída, microserviços e arquitetura orientada a eventos;
  • Conhecimento em automação de testes;
  • Experiência com Java e frameworks como Spring, SpringBoot, Maven, JUnit;
  • Experiência com mensageria e eventos via Kafka (consumo e publicação);
  • Conhecimento em bancos de dados relacionais e não relacionais;
  • Conhecimento de padrões e conceitos de exposição de APIs via API Gateway;
  • Experiência com Oracle SOA Suite 11g/12c (OSB, BPEL, BAM, Rules);
  • Experiência com Oracle Service Bus 11g/12c;
  • Experiência com Web Services (RESTful e SOAP);
  • Conhecimento em Enterprise Manager, DVN, XML, WSDL, WADL, XSD, JSON, xQuery, xPath, Java e PL/SQL;
  • Experiência com modelagem de entidades canônicas (SID);
  • Conhecimento de TMForum;
  • Experiência comprovada em ambientes com grande demanda por integrações;
  • Vivência com JIRA, Quality Center, Jenkins, SVN e GIT .


Desejável:


  • Conhecimento em plataformas de contêiner, especialmente Kubernetes;
  • Conhecimento em pipelines CI/CD;
  • Conhecimento em DataPower;
  • Experiência no setor Telecom .

title: Talent Acquisition Specialist
description:
Who We Are


MAVI is on a mission to globalize the finance and accounting function by connecting the best talent in the world with high-performing US companies. We’re building the world’s largest network of top-tier finance talent, using an AI-powered platform for sourcing, vetting & matching, and disrupting a legacy $100Bn+ industry.


We’re excited to be hiring a Talent Acquisition Specialist to help grow MAVI’s talent network from the hundreds today to millions in the years ahead. Talent acquisition is at the heart of MAVI’s platform, and we’re looking for someone who is creative, resourceful, and data-driven to help us build scalable ways of sourcing and vetting top finance talent across the globe.


You’ll be joining as one of the first dedicated members of our Talent Acquisition (TA) team, working closely with colleagues and founders to shape and expand our network. This is a unique opportunity to make a meaningful impact, build processes from the ground up, and directly influence how we grow.


What You’ll Do:


  • Lead and support end-to-end talent acquisition.
  • Explore, establish, and refine channels for talent sourcing at scale across LATAM (primarily), APAC, and other regions, in close partnership with the engineering team.
  • Build proprietary sourcing networks in key regions, using creative strategies to attract exceptional talent.
  • Guide and improve the vetting process to ensure only the most qualified finance & accounting professionals join MAVI’s network.
  • Define and track key performance metrics for sourcing and vetting to continuously enhance processes and uphold high standards of quality.
  • Collaborate closely with the TA team, founders, and engineering team to introduce automation and efficiencies across sourcing, screening, and vetting.
  • Partner with the TA team and founders to shape the right distribution of skills and profiles in the talent pool, and source accordingly to meet these goals.
  • Consistently work towards meeting and surpassing monthly talent acquisition KPIs.
  • Act as a trusted thought partner to the founders on all aspects of talent acquisition.


What We’re Looking For:


  • 3-8+ years of end-to-end recruiting experience, with some leadership exposure being a plus.
  • Strong ability to source high-quality talent at scale using both active and passive techniques, ideally across multiple regions (with APAC and LATAM experience being especially valuable).
  • Skilled in vetting and interviewing talent, serving as an early filter to assess candidates against defined criteria.
  • Experience experimenting with and refining different sourcing channels and strategies.
  • Comfortable using data to guide sourcing and acquisition decisions, and setting KPIs to measure success.
  • Prior experience recruiting finance & accounting talent is a plus, though not essential.
  • Familiarity with key HR tools (e.g., LinkedIn, job boards, ATS platforms) to support efficient acquisition processes.
  • Ability to thrive in dynamic, fast-moving environments, with flexibility to adapt to change.
  • Strong communication, organizational, and problem-solving skills.
  • A team player who is humble, driven, and passionate about delivering excellence in their work.


Why You Should Join Us:


  • Impact : You’re not just another cog in the machine; you’ll help build the talent acquisition motion ground up that powers the entire business.
  • No Bureaucracy : Work directly with founders, move fast, and own meaningful projects. We’re playing to win here. This is a startup and we’re looking for new ideas, bold moves, and scrappiness.
  • Competitive Pay : We believe in sharing the upside with those who build it.
  • Remote-first: Work from anywhere, but expect high velocity and deep collaboration.


Equal Opportunity Statement


At MAVI, we celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all team members. We welcome applicants of every background, identity, and life experience. Employment decisions are based on business needs, qualifications, and merit, without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, or veteran status.

title: Product Designer (UX/UI)
description:
⚠️ Professional English is a requirement for this role⚠️

⚠️ A challenge will be required ⚠️


About Foundey


Foundey (formerly Uitify) is a design studio specializing in delivering high-quality UI/UX and branding solutions for early-stage SaaS startups based in the United States. We are committed to transforming complex business ideas into elegant, user-centric digital experiences. With a strong emphasis on design excellence, innovation, and client collaboration, we help fast-growing companies establish strong visual identities and seamless digital products.


The Opportunity


We are looking for a highly experienced and strategic Product Designer. This role is ideal for a designer who thrives on solving complex user problems, designing for technical audiences, and delivering intuitive, scalable product experiences in fast-paced, startup environments.

The ideal candidate is a hands-on product thinker with a deep understanding of user-centered design for B2B software, a track record of shipping enterprise-grade digital products, and experience working closely with Product Managers, Engineers, and key stakeholders in the cybersecurity and SaaS sectors.


Responsibilities


  • Lead end-to-end product design processes, from discovery and research to wireframing, prototyping, and high-fidelity UI design;
  • Partner closely with Product Management and Engineering to define product requirements and translate them into user-centered design solutions;
  • Design intuitive interfaces for complex cybersecurity tools and SaaS products, focusing on usability, scalability, and performance;
  • Conduct user research, usability testing, and heuristic evaluations to validate design decisions and optimize user experience
  • Collaborate with stakeholders to align design goals with business objectives, technical constraints, and customer needs;
  • Create and maintain design systems and UI libraries to ensure consistency and efficiency across the product suite;
  • Stay updated on design trends, user behavior patterns in B2B software, and industry best practices in product design;
  • Mentor junior designers and provide design critique and feedback within the team.


Requirements


  • Full professional proficiency in English (verbal and written), with the ability to clearly articulate design rationale and collaborate with international teams;
  • Strong portfolio showcasing complex product design work for enterprise software, especially in security, data visualization, or technical tools;
  • Deep expertise with design tools like Figma, FigJam, and prototyping tools such as Framer or Principle;
  • Solid understanding of user flows, interaction design, information architecture, and visual hierarchy for B2B software;
  • Experience working in agile development environments, with strong collaboration skills alongside Product Managers and Engineers;
  • Familiarity with design systems, accessibility standards (WCAG), and responsive design principles.


Preferred Qualifications


  • 5+ years of experience as a Product Designer
  • Direct experience designing for cybersecurity platforms (e.g., threat detection tools, security dashboards, monitoring platforms, etc.);
  • Background in designing data-heavy interfaces, with complex user journeys and role-based user permissions;
  • Knowledge of frontend development principles (HTML, CSS) to effectively communicate with developers;
  • Prior experience working with US-based startups or product teams;
  • Experience facilitating design workshops, user interviews, or stakeholder alignment sessions.


Why Join Us?


At Foundey, you will work on high-impact projects for fast-growing SaaS and cybersecurity companies, helping shape the digital tools that protect and empower businesses worldwide. You’ll collaborate with talented designers and technologists, contribute to cutting-edge design solutions, and grow your career in a studio that values innovation, ownership, and excellence.


How to Apply


If you’re a product designer with a passion for solving complex problems in the cybersecurity and SaaS space, we’d love to hear from you. Please send your resume and portfolio to and

title: Automation Engineer (n8n) – AI Workflows & Integrations
description:
The Opportunity We are an investment firm building a next-generation \"AI Operating System\" to power our deal flow and investor relations. We are looking for a Low-Code Engineer who can own our operations stack.


We aren't looking for someone to just connect simple triggers (Zapier-style). We need an architect who can build complex, multi-step workflows that fetch unstructured data (call transcripts, email history), process it via LLMs (Claude/GPT), and execute high-stakes communications with precision.


What You Will Build (General Scope)

  • AI-Driven Communications: Workflows that draft hyper-personalized emails to investors and clients by referencing historical data and context.
  • Intelligent Reporting Loops: Systems that periodically query our database to aggregate activity logs and generate strategic summaries for stakeholders.
  • Data Synchronization: Ensuring seamless data flow between our CRM (Attio), Database (Supabase), and Deal Room (Airtable).
  • Contextual RAG: Building logic that pulls specific past interactions (transcripts) to inform future AI outputs.

The Tech Stack

  • Orchestration: n8n (Primary requirement).
  • Database: Supabase (PostgreSQL).
  • CRM: Attio & Airtable.
  • AI: Anthropic (Claude 3.5 Sonnet) & OpenAI APIs.

Who You Are

  • n8n Expert: You are comfortable using Code Nodes (JavaScript) to manipulate JSON data, handle error routing, and manage complex logic trees.
  • Data Literate: You are comfortable writing SQL queries (Supabase) to fetch, filter, and aggregate specific datasets (e.g., \"Fetch interactions from the last 48 hours\").
  • Prompt Engineer: You understand how to structure System vs. User prompts to prevent hallucinations and ensure strict formatting compliance.
  • Detail Oriented: We automate high-value interactions. You understand the importance of testing and \"kill-switches\" to prevent errors.

title: FreeBSD Kernel Testing Engineer (PMC Validation)
description:
Project description

We are looking for an experienced FreeBSD Kernel Testing Engineer to join a project focused on expanding and enhancing the Performance Monitoring Counters (PMC) validation test suite for modern platforms.

The goal of the project is to strengthen the reliability and coverage of FreeBSD's performance monitoring frameworks across core, uncore, and IBS PMCs.

You will be responsible for creating new validation tests, improving existing ones, ensuring correct PMC multiplexing behavior, and enabling proper PMC attachment to live processes in FreeBSD environments.



Skills

Must have

3-5 years of relevant experience

Hands-on experience with modern Unix/Linux kernel validation (FreeBSD kernel validation is a strong bonus)

Strong understanding of performance management frameworks (e.g., PMCs, perf, hardware performance counters)

Solid understanding of x86 architecture, especially performance monitoring hardware

Excellent automation and scripting skills (Python, Shell, or similar)

Experience designing and implementing automated test cases for performance monitoring frameworks

Ability to work with low-level debugging, instrumentation, and system performance tools

English: B2 Upper Intermediate

title: FreeBSD Kernel Testing Engineer (PMC Validation)
description:
Project description

We are looking for an experienced FreeBSD Kernel Testing Engineer to join a project focused on expanding and enhancing the Performance Monitoring Counters (PMC) validation test suite for modern platforms.

The goal of the project is to strengthen the reliability and coverage of FreeBSD's performance monitoring frameworks across core, uncore, and IBS PMCs.

You will be responsible for creating new validation tests, improving existing ones, ensuring correct PMC multiplexing behavior, and enabling proper PMC attachment to live processes in FreeBSD environments.



Skills

Must have

3-5 years of relevant experience

Hands-on experience with modern Unix/Linux kernel validation (FreeBSD kernel validation is a strong bonus)

Strong understanding of performance management frameworks (e.g., PMCs, perf, hardware performance counters)

Solid understanding of x86 architecture, especially performance monitoring hardware

Excellent automation and scripting skills (Python, Shell, or similar)

Experience designing and implementing automated test cases for performance monitoring frameworks

Ability to work with low-level debugging, instrumentation, and system performance tools

English: B2 Upper Intermediate

title: Senior AI Engineer
description:
We are seeking a full-time, remote Senior AI Engineer with 7+ years of software development experience and a strong background building AI native software to join our U.S. client. You will provide leadership and expertise to advance strategic and technical goals of our client.

Our client is venture studio that surrounds industry subject matter experts with senior technical talent to build AI native software solving real-world problems.


Responsibilities

  • Provide strategic and technical expertise to AI-powered, engineering initiatives
  • Advise startups on AI product development using agentic AI, LLMs, and modern AI infrastructure
  • Develop software in conjunction with startup subject matter experts and engineering teams
  • Stay abreast of AI trends and advise colleagues and clients on emerging AI opportunities
  • Communicate across different stakeholder groups including executive, boards, technical, client and industry


Required Experience

  • Excellent written and verbal English communication skills
  • 7+ years of software development experience including AI engineering
  • Strong proficiency in Python
  • Deep experience in AI product development using agents, LLMs, and modern AI infrastructure
  • Expertise with ML/LLM frameworks, such as PyTorch, TensorFlow, LangChain, or equivalent
  • Experience with vector databases, orchestration frameworks, and modern MLOps practices
  • Track record of deploying AI services in production
  • Strong grounding in cloud-native architectures (AWS, GCP, Azure)
  • Proven experience in a vibrant, dynamic startup environment
  • Demonstrated ability to work independently or within a broader team
  • Trustworthy, team-oriented, and transparent


Preferred Experience

  • University degree in a technical field


Additional Information

  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter think big!
  • You get to own your job and be recognized for your contributions
  • Work with smart and creative people
  • Making mistakes is human. Lets learn from them. Be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual no presumptions or judgment. Be the extraordinary you!
  • 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), 1 floating day, 3 sick days, and your national holidays
  • Start: ASAP


About Velozient

We are a privately held, nearshore software development company providing outsourced development resources to North American companies. Our mission is to offer development talent that enjoy taking on challenging work, want to grow their skills and experiences building software, and excel in a fast-paced, dynamic team environment. We are focused on providing world-class remote resources to work as valued client team members. If this type of opportunity excites you, then consider joining our team!

title: Forensic Manager
description:
This leading multinational group, with significant operations across the Americas and worldwide, is seeking an experienced Forensic Manager to lead a team of corporate investigators across their regional operations.


Based in Belo Horizonte, you will be responsible for managing a team of forensic specialists who are overseeing investigations into complex financial crimes, including conflict-of-interest, procurement fraud, misappropriation of assets, corruption, and bribery.


Your role will be primarily focused on team leadership, setting key performance objectives, and building strategic relationships to ensure seamless regional operations. You will have day-to-day responsibility for managing forensic specialists, providing career development guidance, and overseeing resource allocation. Furthermore, you will serve as the primary point of contact for operational management while playing a key role in the overall strategic management of the group’s investigative objectives.


In addition to your leadership duties, you will undertake high-level corporate investigation projects, conduct fraud awareness training, and oversee the integration of data analytics into investigative workflows.


To be successful in this role, you should possess extensive experience in leading complex corporate investigations and managing specialized forensic teams. You are likely currently working in a managerial capacity within a forensic advisory firm or a comparable corporate business.


While a CFE qualification is highly welcomed, we value your proven ability to lead high-performance teams and manage senior stakeholder relationships. Excellent communication skills are essential, and candidates must be fluent in both Portuguese and English. Proficiency in Spanish and experience with advanced data analytics tools are welcomed.


For more information, please see our video

title: Técnico de sustentação
description:
Vaga de Técnico de Sustentação em nossa unidade de negócios de Supply Chain. Oportunidade de suporte , para trabalhar com o software Warehouse Advantage, Infios One (WMS) e com conjunto de softwares de terceiros, como: Sistema operacional Windows, SQL Server/Oracle, software de relatórios e impressões


Responsabilidades no día a día:

Atender usuários por telefone, e-mail ou tickets abertos nas ferramentas usadas pela empresa

Aplicar soluções consultivas e auxiliar na análise de problemas

Garantir a qualidade dos serviços prestados e atingimento do nível de serviço/satisfação acordado.

Consultar as documentações técnicas e fontes alternativas de informação, simulando/testando problemas no ambiente


Qualificação requeridas:


  • 2 anos de experiência em suporte técnico ao cliente
  • Superior Completo ou cursando a partir do 3º semestre em Ciências da Computação, Sistemas de Informação ou áreas afins.
  • Conhecimento básico em banco de dados.
  • Conhecimento em sistemas operacionais Windows e conceitos de rede
  • Perfil analítico, comunicativo, voltado para resolução de problemas
  • Fortes habilidades de atendimento ao cliente e capacidade de multitarefa
  • Capacidade de priorizar tarefas e auto gerenciá-las
  • Conhecimento básico em lógica de programação


Diferencial:


  • Inglês e/ou Espanhol.
  • Conhecimento em logística (WMS)
  • Experiência com programação de computadores e conhecimento básico de linguagens de programação de computadores
  • Experiência com sistemas operacionais e rede de computadores
  • Experiência ou conhecimento em soluções de gerenciamento da cadeia de suprimentos
  • Experiência com a plataforma Korber One e os aplicativos K.Motion Warehouse Advantage

title: PHP/Go DevOps Engineer | 100% Remote
description:
Company Description

MAPRO is a fast-growing SaaS platform serving the vacation rental and property management industry across the United States. We power property management companies with mission-critical software used daily to manage operations, reservations, integrations, and financial workflows.


Role Description

We are hiring a Middle to Senior PHP Backend Developer to join MAPRO , a growing SaaS platform focused on the vacation rental and property management market in the United States.


This position is 100% remote and open to applicants anywhere who are fluent in English and available during US Eastern time commercial hours.


What you will do

  • Develop and maintain backend features using Go and PHP
  • Build and maintain APIs and integrations
  • Improve system performance, scalability and reliability
  • Collaborate on system architecture and technical decisions
  • Support DevOps related tasks and infrastructure improvements


Tech stack

  • Go / PHP / Python
  • MySQL / XtraDB / PostgreSQL / YugabyteDB
  • REST APIs
  • Git / Linux / Bash


What we expect

  • 5+ years of professional experience developing production-grade software
  • Strong backend development skills
  • Experience with APIs and integrations
  • Comfortable working with Linux and development tooling
  • Ability to work independently in a fully remote setup
  • Good technical English reading and writing skills
  • Availability to work aligned with US Eastern Time
  • Great communication skills
  • DevOps experience (CI/CD, Docker, cloud services)
  • Good understanding of basic networking protocols (HTTP, TLS, DNS, SSH, etc)


Nice to have

  • Experience with distributed systems and patterns
  • Previous experience working with fully remote teams
  • Understanding of database systems internals
  • JS/TypeScript/React UI experience


What we offer

  • 100% remote - work from anywhere
  • Competitive salary based on experience
  • Performance based bonuses
  • Work on a real world SaaS product used by US companies
  • Startup environment with room for growth

title: Executive Assistant to Founder (Operations & Projects)
description:
Executive Assistant to Founder (Operations & Projects)


Evvolve | Full-time | Remote

Evvolve is hiring an Executive Assistant to the Founder to support day-to-day execution and ensure operations and projects run smoothly. This role is ideal for a highly organized, proactive professional who can manage multiple workstreams, bring structure to fast-moving priorities, and consistently follow through.

Responsibilities
  • Hiring coordination: publish job posts, manage inbound applicants, schedule interviews, maintain a clear pipeline tracker, and handle candidate follow-ups

title: Performance Video Editor & Ad Designer
description:
Job Title: Performance Video Editor & Ad Designer


About the Company:

Our Client is a dynamic organization focused on creating high-conversion advertising content for a variety of social media platforms. They prioritize direct-response advertising and are dedicated to optimizing creative strategies to improve ad performance.


What You’ll Do:

Our Client is seeking a skilled Video and Image Ad Editor to create high-performing advertising content for paid social platforms. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in editing video ads and designing image ads that drive conversions.


Core Responsibilities:

• Edit high-performing video ads for platforms such as Meta (Facebook/Instagram) and TikTok.

• Transform raw footage, UGC, and creator content into conversion-focused ads with strong hooks, pacing, and retention strategies.

• Design compelling image ads that balance typography, hierarchy, and visual clarity to drive clicks and conversions.

• Create multiple creative variations to support testing strategies and improve ad performance.

• Apply on-image text that is clear, scroll-stopping, and aligned with brand voice.

• Ensure all assets are optimized for platform specs, placements, and mobile-first viewing.


Required Experience and Qualifications:

• Proven experience editing video specifically for e-commerce or direct-response advertising.

• Strong understanding of what makes paid social creative convert, including hooks, pacing, captions, CTAs, and pattern interrupts.

• Ability to create a variety of video ad styles (UGC-inspired, promotional, testimonial, feature-focused, offer-driven).

• Demonstrated ability to design high-quality text-driven image ads built to sell.

• Excellent typography skills, including text hierarchy, readability, spacing, and composition.

• Comfortable producing creative at volume without sacrificing quality.

• Proficiency in tools such as Adobe Creative Suite, Premiere, Photoshop, Illustrator, After Effects, or similar.

• Strong attention to detail with the ability to follow best practices and legal guidelines while exploring new creative directions.

• Ability to take direction, implement feedback quickly, and meet deadlines.


Preferred Skills:

• Experience with direct-response formats and UGC-style editing.

• Familiarity with before/after iterations or creative variations.


Personality:

• Creative thinker with a keen eye for detail.

• Adaptable and open to feedback and new ideas.

• Strong communicator with the ability to work well under pressure.


Software & Tools:

• Adobe Creative Suite

• Premiere

• Photoshop

• Illustrator

• After Effects or similar tools.


English Level:

C2


Schedule:

9-5 EST


Salary and Benefits:

• Payment in USD or Local Currency according to candidate's preference.

title: Senior Backend Engineer
description:
Senior Backend Engineer (Stripe & Fintech Specialist)

Contract: 6–12 months (with possibility of extension)

Engagement Model: Independent Contractor (PJ)


Role Overview

We are looking for a Senior Backend Engineer with deep expertise in Stripe Connect to lead the evolution of a critical payment infrastructure.

This role will be responsible for architecting and implementing a robust Stripe Connect integration within a core Django API, supporting the migration from a legacy Ruby on Rails payment portal.

You will lead the end-to-end payment lifecycle - from onboarding and funds flow to webhook orchestration and complex business logic - ensuring scalability, security, and reliability across payment operations.


Core Responsibilities

  • Architect and implement Stripe Connect integrations (Standard, Express, or Custom) within a Django/Python environment
  • Design and build complex payment flows (split payments, payouts, fee collection)
  • Develop resilient, idempotent webhook processing systems for real-time Stripe events
  • Lead migration of payment logic and data from a legacy Ruby on Rails application into a Django-based architecture
  • Integrate Stripe events with core backend workflows and business processes
  • Implement asynchronous processing using Celery and Redis for high-volume payment tasks
  • Ensure adherence to PCI-DSS standards and best practices for financial data security
  • Build monitoring, alerting, and logging for payment flows (Datadog, Sentry, or similar tools)
  • Write comprehensive unit and integration tests, maintaining high test coverage


Technical Stack

Backend: Python 3.11+, Django 4.x, Django REST Framework (DRF)

Payments: Stripe (Connect, Billing, Webhooks)

Task Queue: Celery, Redis, RabbitMQ (Amazon MQ)

Database: PostgreSQL (Aurora Serverless v2)

Infrastructure: AWS (ECS Fargate, ElastiCache)


What We’re Looking For

  • Strong experience building production-grade payment systems
  • Deep understanding of Stripe Connect and marketplace payment architectures
  • Experience migrating legacy systems to modern backend frameworks
  • Solid knowledge of asynchronous architectures and event-driven systems
  • Strong ownership mindset and ability to lead complex backend initiatives

title: B2B Growth Lead
description:
Company Description

The Institute of Project Management (IPM) is a globally recognized leader in project management education, certification, membership, and research, with over 35 years of experience. IPM has empowered more than 50,000 professionals and certified over 6,000 Project Managers while partnering with 1000+ organizations worldwide. Known for its integrated, three-stage professional journey, IPM supports career progression from Project Management to Project Directorship. The organization collaborates with top certification bodies, universities, and industry leaders to shape international project management standards. IPM is committed to inclusivity and accessibility through initiatives like IPM Hub, mentorship programs, and regional events.

Role Overview

This is a full-time remote role for a B2B Growth Lead focused on building and scaling IPM’s outbound and partner-led revenue engine. You will own B2B outreach end-to-end, from identifying the right accounts to initiating conversations and moving qualified opportunities into structured sales discussions. This role sits at the intersection of strategy and execution and works closely with leadership to continuously refine how we go to market.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own B2B outreach end-to-end across email, LinkedIn, and partner-led channels
  • Research and identify high-fit accounts, organisations, and decision-makers
  • Craft thoughtful, personalised outreach messages that start meaningful conversations
  • Initiate and manage early-stage conversations with prospects and partners
  • Qualify opportunities and progress them into structured sales discussions with the wider sales team
  • Collaborate closely with leadership to refine targeting, messaging, and outreach strategy
  • Track outreach activity, responses, and outcomes, using data to improve conversion and effectiveness over time

What We’re Looking For

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to personalise outreach and build rapport
  • Proven experience in B2B outreach, lead generation, or early-stage sales conversations
  • Comfort researching accounts and navigating decision-maker conversations
  • A structured, organised approach to tracking outreach and follow-ups (CRM familiarity preferred)
  • Self-motivated and able to work independently in a remote environment
  • Experience working with corporate clients, partnerships, or professional services is a plus
  • Exposure to education, training, or professional certification environments is helpful but not required

title: Senior Quality Assurance Engineer (RST)
description:
We are looking for a full-time, remote Senior QA Engineer (RST) with 5+ years of experience, who plays a critical role in driving a quality-first, insight-driven approach throughout the software development lifecycle.


This position is part of an experimental initiative to evaluate the effectiveness of Rapid Software Testing (RST) practices within the organization. Your success in this role will be measured by the quality of the insights and risk identification you provide to the team, not by the volume of test artifacts or automation output. This role is expected to improve visibility into product risk, support informed release decisions, and demonstrate the value of Rapid Software Testing in a real-world production environment.


The ideal candidate is a strong tester first—capable of investigating complex systems, adapting testing strategies to context, and clearly communicating risk—while also contributing to test automation using existing frameworks when appropriate. The position emphasizes skilled exploratory testing, critical thinking, and risk analysis to provide meaningful insights into product quality and release confidence. Automation is used intentionally to support testing where it delivers clear value; however, testing skill and judgment are the primary focus of this role, not the tool process.

Our client provides integrated software and marketing solutions for the hospitality industry, specializing in short-term rental management. Their platform provides vacation rental companies with a Property Management System, integrates with booking, guest communications, and financial reporting systems, and is designed for partner organization .


Responsibilities

  • Lead the organization's adoption of Rapid Software Testing using context-driven testing principles for large-scale, web-based, and SaaS systems
  • Mentor and coach QA Engineers on Rapid Software Testing practices, including exploratory testing, and critical thinking
  • Contribute to the evolution of test design and coverage - share effective investigative techniques that produce previously undiscovered insights through the utilization of heuristics (e.g., SFDPOT, HICCUPPS, RCRCRC), and system modeling techniques
  • Plan and perform functional, E2E, and regression testing with an emphasis on learning and discovery
  • Design and execute exploratory testing sessions to identify critical risks, edge cases, and unexpected system behavior
  • Continuously assess what testing is most valuable based on product context, constraints, and evolving understanding
  • Perform deep investigation of defects to understand root causes and systemic risk, not just surface symptoms
  • Collaborate closely with Product and Engineering teams to clarify requirements, challenge assumptions, and improve testability
  • Act as a quality advocate by surfacing risk early and supporting informed decision-making
  • Participate in design, refinement, and technical discussions to provide testing insight and risk-based feedback
  • Provide clear and concise test summaries that focus on risk, impact, coverage, unknowns, mitigations, and confidence levels rather than pass/fail metrics
  • Evaluate and articulate when automation is appropriate and when exploratory testing provides greater value
  • Collaborate with automation-focused engineers to ensure automated checks complement exploratory testing efforts – contribute automation tests using automation frameworks (Playwright, Karate, etc.) as appropriate, especially for stable repetitive high-risk scenarios


Required Experience

  • Excellent English communication skills, written and verbal
  • 5+ years of experience in Quality Assurance or Software Testing for web-based and/or SaaS applications
  • 2+ years of direct experience using the Rapid Software Testing methodology
  • Strong hands-on experience with exploratory testing and context-driven testing approaches, with the ability to assess risk effectively, model system behavior, and adapt testing strategies as understanding evolves
  • Experience communicating test coverage and quality risk without reliance on exhaustive scripted test cases
  • Working knowledge of Playwright, Karate, Selenium, or similar tools sufficient to add or maintain automated checks
  • Proficiency in at least one programming or scripting language (Java, JavaScript, TypeScript, or )
  • Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines and how automated checks fit into release workflows
  • Solid understanding of REST APIs, backend validation, and SQL for data verification
  • Strong critical thinking and problem-solving abilities
  • Comfortable working in ambiguous, fast-changing environments
  • Self-directed, curious, and proactive in identifying risks and improvement opportunities
  • Passionate about testing as a skill and discipline, not just tool execution


Desired Experience

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or some technical engineering
  • Familiarity with the hospitality industry, including reservations, bookings, and payment processing


Success in this Role

Success is measured by the quality of insights and risk identification provided to the team, not by the volume of test artifacts or automation output. This role is expected to improve visibility into product risk, support informed release

decisions, and demonstrate the value of Rapid Software Testing in a real-world production environment

Additional Information

  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter, think big!
  • You get to own your job and be recognized for your contributions
  • Work with innovative and creative people
  • Making mistakes is human. Let's learn from them. Be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual, with no presumptions or judgment. Be the extraordinary you!
  • 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), one floating day, three sick days, and designated national holidays
  • Start: ASAP

We are looking for a remote, full-time Full Stack Engineer with 3+ years of experience in React.js, TypeScript, and Ruby on Rails to join the core development team of our U.S. client. You will design, build, and deliver the best financial software on the planet!


Our client is a fintech company that provides commodities managers with task automation and timely insights on their trades, including risk exposure, positions, and profits and losses. With over 5 million trades on its SaaS platform, the company is an award-winning industry leader that counts some of the world's largest financial firms as customers. Our client is growing rapidly and is looking for smart, bold risk-takers to further its product strategy of market disruption and expansion.


Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, and test new features for the clients next-gen trading platform
  • Write efficient, maintainable, and reusable code
  • Utilize AI tooling, such as Cursor and CodeRabbit, to accelerate software development
  • Participate in and support the full continuous testing and delivery pipeline
  • Join the engineering support rotation, assisting the Customer Success team
  • Write and maintain unit, integration, and feature tests
  • Review code and tests written by other team members
  • Identify and eliminate technical debt
  • Accept, act on, and provide feedback in a timely manner
  • Seek and provide timely technical assistance and clarification.
  • Collaborate with and mentor team members
  • Learn new technologies (and help your teammates learn them too)
  • Support the clients growth by contributing to open-source projects and representing the client within the developer community


Required Experience

  • Excellent English communication and teamwork skills
  • 3+ years of experience developing full stack applications with React.js and Ruby on Rails
  • Experience with TypeScript, SQL-compliant databases, Go, Python, or other open-source and commercial technologies, such as Kafka and RabbitMQ
  • Proficient in the use of AI tooling such as Cursor and GitHub CoPilot
  • Experience with high-volume, event-based system architectures and Agile software development practices
  • A self-disciplined, task-oriented approach to development, testing, and code structure
  • Desire to work in an environment that:
  • Embraces diversity
  • Maintains a client-centric approach to building products
  • Strives to maintain a world-class organization
  • Loves technology
  • Gives back to the community
  • Proven ability to stay self-motivated, work hard, own problems from start to finish, and bring order from chaos
  • Demonstrated ability to work independently or as part of a broader team.
  • Trustworthy, team-oriented, transparent, and fun


Preferred Experience

  • University degree in Computer Science, a related field of study, or equivalent experience
  • Experience in finance and/or energy, commodities, or equity trading
  • Experience with enterprise-grade software and highly secure, multi-tenant SaaS solutions
  • Experience with Docker and Kubernetes
  • Experience with real-time, data-streaming technologies such as Kafka
  • Experience with Ember


Additional Information

  • Know that your ideas are heard and matter think big!
  • Own your job and be recognized for your contributions
  • Work with smart, creative people
  • Making mistakes is human. Lets learn from them and be transparent!
  • Be recognized as an individual no presumptions or judgment. Be the extraordinary you!
  • 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), 1 floating day, 3 sick days, and designated national holidays
  • Start: ASAP


About Velozient

We are a privately held, nearshore software development company providing outsourced development resources to North American companies. Our mission is to offer development talent who enjoy taking on challenging work, want to grow their skills and experiences building software, and excel in a fast-paced, dynamic team environment. We are focused on providing world-class remote resources to work as valued client team members. If this type of opportunity excites you, then consider joining our team!

title: Senior Accountant
description:
We are supporting a fast-growing technology company in the logistics space in the search for a highly skilled Senior Accounting Professional to join their finance team.


This role will play a key part in strengthening financial processes, ensuring IFRS/GAAP compliance, and driving data-driven insights across the business.


Key Responsibilities include:

• Leading journal entries across revenue, commissions, bonuses, intercompany and cost allocations

• Reviewing balance sheet reconciliations and monthly close activities

• Ensuring expense compliance and accurate financial reporting under IFRS

• Building and improving accounting policies, internal controls, and processes

• Supporting audits and complex accounting treatments

• Delivering monthly financial reporting and budget vs actual analysis

• Leveraging SQL, Python, Excel and AI to generate insights and improve efficiency


What we’re looking for:

• Bachelor’s degree in Accounting (CPA or equivalent required)

• 5+ years of relevant experience (preferably from public accounting or high-growth environments)

• Strong IFRS and U.S. GAAP knowledge

• Advanced Excel skills

• Experience with internal controls and SOX

• Fluent in English

• Comfortable working in fast-paced startup environments

title: Business Development Representative
description:
Job Title: Outreach Specialist / Appointment Setter


Schedule: Full-time (40 hs/week).


Location: Fully remote, async-first.


About This Role:

Our client is looking for a dedicated and hungry Outreach Specialist to fuel their sales pipeline. This is a junior-to-mid-level role for a \"hunter\" who thrives on chasing leads and booking qualified meetings. You will be the engine of the sales process, responsible for the initial contact that turns cold prospects into warm opportunities.


We are looking for an Operator , not just a list-builder. You must be able to execute high-volume outreach across multiple channels (Cold Call, Email, LinkedIn) and diagnose what is working to optimize your results.


Responsibilities:

  • Meeting Generation: Your primary KPI is the number of qualified meetings booked per week and per month.
  • Omnichannel Outreach: Execute campaigns using Cold Calling, Email, and LinkedIn. You have the autonomy to use the channels that yield the best results.
  • Metric Tracking: Meticulously track your daily activity (volume of outreach) and your success rates (meetings booked).
  • Pipeline Management: Ensure no lead falls through the cracks; manage follow-ups religiously until a \"No\" or a \"Yes\" is achieved.
  • Feedback Loop: Provide feedback to the strategy team on lead quality and market response to improve targeting.

Requirements:

  • 2-3 years of experience (Minimum) in outreach, appointment setting, or SDR roles.
  • Proven Track Record: Must be able to demonstrate historical success rates (specifically: Average Meetings Generated per Month) from previous roles.
  • Tool Agnostic: Experience with any standard outreach tools (e.g., Apollo, Lemlist, Sales Navigator, RingCentral) is accepted.
  • High Availability: Willingness to work 40 hours/week.
  • Communication: Strong written and verbal English skills for cold calling and email copywriting.

title: Senior Software Developer (React.js / Node.js)
description:
We are looking for a remote, full-time Senior Software Developer with 5+ years of software development experience and a strong background in React.js and Node.js to join our U.S. client's engineering team. You will lead, develop and enhance SaaS products used by thousands of customers. title: Fechador
description:
APENAS APLIQUE SE VOCÊ TEM EXPERIÊNCIA COM VENDAS HIGH TICKET E HISTÓRICO DE METAS BATIDAS


Sobre a HarmonizaPRO: Somos a maior aceleradora comercial para clinicas de harmonização facial do Brasil! Impactamos mais de 400 clinicas ao longo de 5 anos. Nosso papel é aumentar demanda, ticket médio e implementar um departamento comercial terceirizado para nós na clínica. Dessa forma conseguimos garantir o paciente sentado na cadeira da nossa cliente.


Se você tem experiência com vendas e busca um lugar de destaque em uma empresa em ascenção, essa vaga é para você. A HarmonizaPRO tem 48 colaboradores, investimos 150k+ em anúncios por mês e temos uma meta agressiva para esse ano. Temos uma CIA com pessoas idôneas e ambiciosas, todos aqui querem botar mais dinheiro no bolso e procuramos pessoas com o mesmo perfil cultural.


Ponto de extrema importância: mais do que um bom vendedor, estamos buscando um(a) excelente consultor(a). Aquela pessoa que conhece sobre negócios e ditará o melhor programa/produto para o cliente é quem buscamos. Se você pensa em apenas fazer um \"bico\" aqui, pegar algumas calls e tratar como um hobbie, pode passar para frente, não queremos você.

Queremos pessoas comprometidas, que tenham empatia com o sonho dos demais colaboradores e dos clientes para mantermos um ambiente de desenvolvimento contínuo.

Respiramos e vibramos a cada venda, mas o destaque sempre será nas vendas em que proporcionamos aos nossos clientes, essas vibramos ainda mais!

A HarmonizaPRO é uma ferramenta de transformação de vidas, e ela pode mudar a sua também.


  • Responsabilidades:
  • Conduzir reuniões de vendas consultivas (média 4-6 calls/dia)
  • Fechar contratos de R$12k a R$60k
  • Gerir seu pipeline no Pipedrive com disciplina
  • Nutrir leads com follow-ups estratégicos
  • Participar das rotinas do time (daily, weekly, 1:1)


  • Requisitos:
  • Experiência comprovada como vendedor (com resultados para mostrar)
  • Comunicação consultiva
  • Disciplina de processo e CRM
  • Proatividade e capacidade de resolver problemas sem precisar de babá
  • Ambição real de ganhar dinheiro
  • Conversão acima de 20%


  • Remuneração:
  • R$5.000,00 fixo inicial.
  • Comissão de 3% sobre o valor recebido, podendo chegar a 5% com progressão de taxa de conversão de vendas (média salarial de 12k a 28k).
  • +Bônus por metas batidas.


  • Regime de contratação: PJ.
  • Modelo de trabalho: Remoto, mas temos sede presencial para trabalhar também
  • Horário: Integral.
  • Apesar do contrato ser PJ, prezamos pela sua exclusividade com nossa empresa.

Se você pensa em apenas fazer um \"bico\" aqui, pegar algumas calls e tratar como um hobbie, pode passar para frente, não queremos você.

Queremos pessoas comprometidas, que tenham empatia com o sonho dos demais colaboradores e dos clientes para mantermos um ambiente de desenvolvimento contínuo.

Respiramos e vibramos a cada venda, mas o destaque sempre será nas vendas em que proporcionamos aos nossos clientes, essas vibramos ainda mais!

A HarmonizaPRO é uma ferramenta de transformação de vidas, e ela pode mudar a sua também.


  • Responsabilidades:
  • Conduzir reuniões de vendas consultivas (média 4-6 calls/dia)
  • Fechar contratos de R$12k a R$60k
  • Gerir seu pipeline no Pipedrive com disciplina
  • Nutrir leads com follow-ups estratégicos
  • Participar das rotinas do time (daily, weekly, 1:1)


  • Requisitos:
  • Experiência comprovada como vendedor (com resultados para mostrar)
  • Comunicação consultiva
  • Disciplina de processo e CRM
  • Proatividade e capacidade de resolver problemas sem precisar de babá
  • Ambição real de ganhar dinheiro
  • Conversão acima de 20%


  • Remuneração:
  • R$5.000,00 fixo inicial.
  • Comissão de 3% sobre o valor recebido, podendo chegar a 5% com progressão de taxa de conversão de vendas (média salarial de 12k a 28k).
  • +Bônus por metas batidas.


  • Regime de contratação: PJ.
  • Modelo de trabalho: Remoto, mas temos sede presencial para trabalhar também
  • Horário: Integral.
  • Apesar do contrato ser PJ, prezamos pela sua exclusividade com nossa empresa.

title: Node Developer - Remote
description:
At INDI, we're passionate about empowering individuals and businesses worldwide. Our cutting-edge recruiters connect leading companies with top talent, fostering a dynamic environment where innovation thrives. Join us in shaping the future of work.

- Testing & Deployment: Experience in automated tests and CI/CD pipelines.

- Version Control: Strong experience with version control systems.

- Language Skills: Advanced English level.

• Flexibility: Choose where and how you work for enhanced creativity and innovation.

• Tailored Compensation: Personalize your earnings to suit your financial goals.

• Tech-Driven Tools: Access cutting-edge resources for seamless collaboration and productivity.

• Autonomous Workflow: Take control of your schedule to achieve work-life balance.

• Well-being: Enjoy generous leave policies for rest and rejuvenation.

• Diversity & Inclusion: Thrive in a diverse and inclusive environment.

• Collaboration: Engage with industry leaders for collective growth.

• Development: Access mentorship and growth opportunities for continuous advancement.


If you are interested in being part of a team composed of the best professionals and working 100% goal-oriented in an innovative environment, but with the structure and resources of a multinational market leader, do not hesitate to apply!

title: Senior Software Engineer
description:
Senior Software Engineer


Language: Portuguese & English

Position: Remote

Experience: Senior


Key Responsibilities

  • Design develop and implement scalable middleware APIs and backend services to support user management and other API services across our client using Java with Spring Boot and Golang capable of handling thousands of requests per second RPS;
  • Optimize and manage existing high performance systems and services on both AWS and GCP;
  • Integrate with services across the streaming platform to ensure seamless functionality;
  • Leverage GCP technologies such as PubSub, GKE and Cloud SQL to create robust scalable systems;
  • Maintain and support AWS technologies including EKS, ECS, Lambda, Elasticache, AuroraRDS and Step Functions during the transition period;
  • Promote coding excellence and enforce best practices for building scalable high through put systems;
  • Actively participate in the design and architecture phases of new features and services ensuring scalability and performance;
  • Mentor junior team members providing guidance on building scalable middleware APIs and backend services;
  • Contribute to technical strategy and roadmaps for both AWS and GCP environments;
  • Collaborate with cross functional agile teams of software engineers, data engineers, ML experts and others to deliver new product features.


Mandatory Knowledge

  • Bachelors or Masters degree in Computer Science or related field or equivalent work experience;
  • 10 years of experience in software development;
  • Proficiency in Java with Spring Boot for developing scalable backend services;
  • Experience with Golang and familiarity with cloud technologies eg EKS, ECS, Lambda Elasticache, AuroraRDS, SQS, SNS, Step Functions;
  • Hands on experience with GCP technologies including PubSub, Kubernetes, MySQL and Spanner;
  • Strong technical communication skills to articulate complex solutions;
  • Exceptional interpersonal skills with the ability to collaborate effectively in a global cross functional environment with internal stakeholders and customers.



Does this sounds like something you'd like to do?

Apply and attach your resume in English and we'll take it from here. Excited to meet you!

title: Graphic Designer (B2B Marketing)
description:
Graphic Designer (B2B Marketing)


Position Summary


We are seeking an experienced Graphic Designer to join our marketing team and help bring our brand and services to life across print and digital channels. This role is ideal for a designer with a strong background in B2B marketing , who can translate complex ideas into clear, compelling visuals that inform, engage, and inspire professional audiences.


The Graphic Designer will collaborate closely with marketing and business development to create high-quality assets that align with brand standards and support business goals. From concept through execution, this role plays a key part in ensuring visual consistency and excellence across all customer touchpoints.


Note: please provide link to portfolio of work. Applications without a portfolio will not be accepted.


Key Responsibilities


Design & Creative Execution

title: Java Fullstack Developer (Angular)
description:
About You

You are a software engineer who enjoys building robust, scalable, and well-structured applications. You’re motivated by clean architecture, modern technologies, and meaningful collaboration across backend and frontend layers. You’re looking for a place where you can grow professionally, influence technical decisions, and contribute to high-impact products used by real customers.


You Bring to Applaudo the Following Competencies:

  • Bachelor’s degree or higher in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field.
  • 6+ years of professional experience developing backend solutions using Java (21+) and Spring Boot.
  • Strong experience building and maintaining monolithic backend applications following clean architecture principles.
  • Hands-on experience with PostgreSQL and in-memory data stores such as Redis.
  • Proven experience working with AWS services, including S3, ECS, CloudWatch, and Bedrock.
  • Experience using MyBatis as an ORM and Liquibase for database versioning and migrations.
  • 2+ years of professional experience with Angular (v19 or similar), with strong usage of RxJS and Observables.
  • Familiarity with frontend monolith architectures and modern client-side frameworks.
  • Advanced knowledge of Git and version control best practices.
  • Advanced English proficiency is required, as you will work directly with US-based clients.


You Will Be Accountable for the Following Responsibilities:

  • Participate in collaborative concept definition, architectural refinement, and software design across backend and frontend layers.
  • Design, build, and maintain scalable monolithic applications using Java 21 and Spring Boot.
  • Develop and maintain RESTful APIs and integrate them with Angular frontend applications using RxJS and Observables.
  • Implement and manage data persistence using PostgreSQL, MyBatis, Liquibase, and Redis.
  • Work with AWS infrastructure services (S3, ECS, CloudWatch, Bedrock) to support application deployment, monitoring, and observability.
  • Follow Agile practices, working independently while collaborating closely with a cross-functional team.
  • Maintain high-quality technical documentation throughout the SDLC.


Qualifications

  • Hands-on experience with: Java 21, Spring Boot, PostgreSQL, Redis, Monolithic architecture design and development, AWS (S3, ECS, CloudWatch), Angular (v19 or similar), RxJS / Observables, MyBatis and Liquibase.
  • Strong communication skills in English and Spanish.


Additional Information

About Us


At Applaudo , we partner with ambitious companies to transform through technology with an AI-native mindset at the core of how we think, build, and deliver. We combine strategic clarity, world-class execution, and modern engineering practices to help clients accelerate measurable business outcomes and stay competitive.


We are building a high-performance culture grounded in five values: Empowering Excellence, Collaborative Teamwork, Unsolicited Respect, Consistent Transparency, and Efficient Communication. These define how we work, how we make decisions, and how we hold ourselves accountable.


Applaudo is a place for people who want to grow fast, take ownership, and work alongside strong teams. Joining us means being part of an organization that is evolving intentionally, investing in modern ways of working, and embracing AI as a lever for productivity, innovation, and impact.

title: Junior Node Developer - Remote
description:
At INDI, we're passionate about empowering individuals and businesses worldwide. Our cutting-edge recruiters connect leading companies with top talent, fostering a dynamic environment where innovation thrives. Join us in shaping the future of work.


Overview of the role:


We are looking for Junior Node Developers to join our Development team and participate in different projects made up of multicultural teams distributed throughout the world. We are looking for proactive people, team players passionate about programming in this language and oriented to provide the best experience to the end user. This is an excellent opportunity for those professionals looking to develop in one of the fastest growing companies in the industry!

These developers will face numerous technical challenges, so they must use current technologies, get involved in the mobile world, web applications, devices, etc.


Key responsibilities:


- Architect Bandit backend systems using the best practice.

- Implement and iterate features in a tactical manner and rapid pace.

- Work collaboratively and efficiently across functional teams in a fast paced early stage startup environment.

- Design, extend, and implement APIs.

- High standard of engineering quality through code reviews, unit tests, analytics.

- Create engineering efficiencies through automation and development of tools.

- Define engineering processes for product launch and releases.

- Help us grow the world class engineering team via by running technical interviews.


Requirements:


- 1+ year of experience in Node development.

- Experience in Video and HLS.

- Advanced English level.


Benefits:

• Flexibility: Choose where and how you work for enhanced creativity and innovation.

• Tailored Compensation: Personalize your earnings to suit your financial goals.

• Tech-Driven Tools: Access cutting-edge resources for seamless collaboration and productivity.

• Autonomous Workflow: Take control of your schedule to achieve work-life balance.

• Well-being: Enjoy generous leave policies for rest and rejuvenation.

• Diversity & Inclusion: Thrive in a diverse and inclusive environment.

• Collaboration: Engage with industry leaders for collective growth.

• Development: Access mentorship and growth opportunities for continuous advancement.


If you are interested in being part of a team composed of the best professionals and working 100% goal-oriented in an innovative environment, but with the structure and resources of a multinational market leader, do not hesitate to apply!

title: Paid Social Specialist
description:
Required Experience
  • ~2 years of hands-on experience working inside Meta Ads Manager.
  • Strong familiarity with the platform’s layout and workflows (you know where things are and how to navigate efficiently).
  • Working understanding of how campaigns, ad sets, and ads function together.
  • Experience executing common tasks such as launching ads, making budget changes, editing ad sets, and troubleshooting basic delivery issues.
  • Comfortable following established processes while learning more advanced strategy over time.
Role Overview

We’re looking for a detail-oriented Paid Social Specialist to support our strategists by owning day-to-day Meta Ads implementation and operational execution. This role is ideal for someone who has hands-on experience inside Meta Ads Manager, understands how campaigns are structured, and knows where to find things—but is still early in their career and eager to learn fast.

You’ll work closely with a Strategist, executing scoped tasks, monitoring accounts daily, and maintaining clean documentation so the team can move faster with fewer mistakes. This is a high-trust, high-learning role with a clear growth path as responsibility and autonomy increase.


Key Responsibilities

Platform Execution & Learning

  • Complete structured training on Meta Ads Manager and internal reporting tools, applying learnings through supervised account work.
  • Execute scoped changes such as ad creation, ad set updates, budget adjustments, and basic optimizations with pre-launch review.
  • Follow established processes, checklists, and templates to ensure accuracy and consistency.

Daily Monitoring & Issue Escalation

  • Monitor accounts daily for spend pacing, delivery issues, ad rejections, and early signs of creative fatigue.
  • Flag issues quickly and clearly, escalating with context and suggested next steps when appropriate.

Documentation & Operational Support

  • Maintain accurate documentation including change logs, creative tracking sheets, call notes, and action items.
  • Keep internal systems up to date so anyone on the team can quickly understand account status and history.

Creative & Strategy Support

  • Support brief development by gathering inputs, pulling reference ads, and documenting historical creative performance.
  • Help organize creative assets and performance data to support testing and iteration.

Client Call Support

  • Join client calls primarily to observe, take structured notes, and track follow-ups.
  • Occasionally deliver small, prepared updates with coaching and guidance.


Success Metrics (KPIs)
  • Quality assurance score and error rate trend (improving month over month).
  • Percentage of tasks delivered on time and correctly documented.
  • Monitoring effectiveness (issues identified early, response time).
  • Training milestone completion and demonstrated skill progression.


What We’re Looking For
  • Prior hands-on experience using Meta Ads Manager (you know how campaigns, ad sets, and ads work and where to find things).
  • Strong attention to detail and comfort following structured processes.
  • Clear written communication and organized note-taking.
  • Ability to execute independently once scoped, while knowing when to ask questions or escalate.
  • Curiosity and desire to improve—not just “get tasks done.”


Nice to Have
  • Experience supporting paid social campaigns for e-commerce.
  • Familiarity with basic performance metrics (CPA, ROAS, CTR, CPM).
  • Experience working with templates, SOPs, or QA processes.


Why This Role Matters

This role increases the team’s bandwidth by taking ownership of execution and operational rigor, allowing strategists to focus on higher-level thinking, creative direction, and client outcomes. If you’re looking to deepen your paid social skills in a structured, high-learning environment, this role is built for that.
